newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to trade two new equity options next week.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to trade two new equity options next week.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Friday it will list options on Pioneer Natural Resources Co Aug 11 and on Aviron Aug 14.

The exchange said Pioneer Natural options will open with strikes of 35, 40 and 45, with position limits of 7,500 contracts. Initial expirations will be in September, October, December and March. J. Streicher & Co will be the specialist.

For Aviron options, opening strikes will be at 25, 30 and 35, with positions limits of 7,500 contracts. Expirations have been set for September, October, November and February. Cohen, Duffy & McGowan Inc will be the specialist.
